ui_bugs.issue: Promise.all(['/billing/plans','/billing/me']) makes the whole plans grid + restore button hidden when /billing/me 401s (unauthenticated). Anonymous visitors see only the trial-card and a 'Couldn't load plans / Not authenticated' modal even though /billing/plans is a public endpoint. Recommend wrapping /billing/me in its own try/catch so plans always render. Reference: /app/frontend/app/premium.tsx:72-86

action_items: Fix /premium so that /billing/plans renders even when /billing/me 401s. Decouple the two requests so anonymous users can still browse plans + Restore.
Migrate expo-av usage to expo-audio (and expo-video if video playback exists). Voice dictation/recording likely uses expo-av today.
Replace deprecated Image style.resizeMode with the resizeMode prop where applicable.
critical_code_review_comments: premium.tsx: Promise.all collapses on a single failing dependency; consider Promise.allSettled or two separate try/catch so the public plans grid is resilient when /billing/me is unauthenticated.
Auth gating for /premium is unclear: route appears reachable without a session but client fetches /billing/me which requires auth — either gate /premium behind auth or make /billing/me non-fatal.

rca_of_issue: Anonymous /premium hides plans+restore: app/premium.tsx wraps both api('/billing/plans') and api('/billing/me') inside Promise.all and a single try/catch. Because /billing/me requires a Bearer session, an unauthenticated visit makes Promise.all reject; setData(plans) never runs, so the entire {data && (...)} JSX block — including <PlanCard> and Restore — stays hidden, and only the static trial-card remains visible plus a 'Not authenticated' modal. Mitigation: fetch plans first (no auth), then attempt billing/me separately and ignore 401, OR gate the /premium route behind the auth context.
